parent_objective: materialize matched-budget profile training configs and command matrix without running training
blocked_by: M2226 design must freeze profile matrix, budgets, seeds, quality floors, and admission route

public_gates: M2227 must materialize exactly the M2226 primary trainable profile matrix
M2227 must use the same total_steps, rollout_steps, num_envs, update_epochs, minibatch_size, learning_rate, clip_coef, max_grad_norm, eval_episodes, and seed set for every trained profile
M2227 must preserve the P0 human-view no-wheel no-oracle actor contract
M2227 must write a training command matrix and claim boundary
M2227 must not run reset, rollout, measured execution, policy action, training, replay, or PPO
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns matched-budget design into deterministic config and command artifacts
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: config materialization only; no training rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if budgets differ across trainable profiles
stop if generated configs violate actor input contract
stop if materialization starts training or rollout
fallback_plan: route to config repair if materialization fails
route to training execution design if materialization is clean
route to synthesis if matched-budget matrix is too expensive

admission_evidence: M2226 primary profile matrix and budget fields are explicit
allowed_updates: M2227 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by materialization

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2227 materializes configs and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2227.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Materialized configs must support fair finite-window and GRU outcomes without assuming a winner.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: enables fair profile training before comparison
must_synthesize_if: M2227 would require profile-specific config tuning

hypothesis: M2226 matched-budget design can be materialized into contract-clean config and command artifacts without running training.
success_criteria: generated configs exist for each trainable profile and seed
all trained profiles use matched budgets and seeds
no reset rollout measured execution training ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: new rollout or training is performed
decision_rule: M2227 passes if it materializes matched-budget configs and command matrix without training or contract violations.
